About us We make experience accessible. An elite Israeli cyber security firm built on a single conviction — that real expertise should not be a privilege. We accelerate it, exposing people, teams and decision-makers to real-world, hands-on practice across industries. Talk to HackersEye Meet the founders Who we are Operators, not observers. HackersEye is an elite Israeli cyber security firm . We work the way attackers think — methodical, relentless, and unforgiving of the gaps everyone else overlooks. Through years of tackling real-world incidents, we identified the root cause of security breaches: the Human Factor — a lack of awareness, inexperienced personnel, and an insufficient workforce. We close that gap end to end — a 24/7 incident-response cell, a follow-the-sun SOC powered by our own AI-assisted Suite, offensive testing, consulting, and our hands-on Range. Our mission We believe experience shouldn't be a privilege, but a necessity . To combat this, we accelerate expertise by exposing individuals, teams and decision-makers to real-world, hands-on practice across industries. By making experience accessible, we're not just closing gaps — we're making the world a safer place. 01 Attacker's point of view We see your organisation the way an adversary does — then we close the door before they find it. Every engagement starts from offence. 02 Experience, accelerated Skill is built under pressure, not in slides. We put people into real-world, hands-on practice so readiness is earned long before it is tested. 03 A safer world Closing the human-factor gap across industries isn't a tagline — it's the outcome we measure ourselves against, one organisation at a time. 04 When it burns, we step in Our 24/7 incident-response cell takes command in the first hour — containment, forensics, and the calls that keep a bad day small. 05 AI carries the load. People stay in command. Our proprietary Suite puts agentic AI behind every alert — and our experts govern every call. Faster, and never a black box. 06 A watch that never ends A follow-the-sun SOC watches your whole estate around the clock — cutting the noise, catching what's real, and reaching out only when it matters. The more you sweat in training, the less you bleed in battle. Security from an attacker's point of view Leadership The founders behind the work.
